description: The XC FEA community maintains XC, an open-source finite-element analysis program for civil engineering structures. Its repository describes linear and nonlinear, static and dynamic structural analyses and publishes examples and documentation. Users prepare structural elements, materials, supports and applied actions; numerical outputs describe displacements, forces and response for the chosen case. The geographic scope is site-scale and follows the structure entered by the analyst. GitHub metadata states GPL-3.0 licensing and the source repository remains active. A limitation is that a solver result depends on suitable element formulations, constitutive laws and load assumptions. Validation against measurements or reference cases is still needed for a particular bridge, building or retaining structure. XC can model structural behaviour in earthquake and resilience studies. The related catalogue OpenSees model is a separate open structural solver and is not the same repository or implementation. No XC binaries, examples or datasets were downloaded or run.
inputs: Finite elements, material laws, supports and structural actions
